title: Vedantu Alternative for Tutors (2026): Run Your Own Tuition
description: For tutors weighing teaching with Vedantu against their own online tuition: what Vedantu publishes for teachers, when it fits, and how to run your own batches and fees.
og_description: Vedantu is a live-class brand teachers apply to, not software you buy. A fair look at teaching with Vedantu, running your own online tuition, or both, quoting only Vedantu's own pages, checked 24 Oct 2026.
h1: Vedantu Alternative for Tutors (2026): Teach with Vedantu, Run Your Own Online Tuition, or Do Both
dek: Vedantu is a live online class brand that teachers apply to, not software you subscribe to. This guide compares a K-12 tutor's real options, quoting only what Vedantu publishes on its own pages.
cover_alt: Vedantu alternative for tutors: teach with Vedantu, run your own online tuition with your own app, or do both
audience: K-12 and CBSE tuition teachers in India weighing teaching for a live-class brand against running their own online tuition
intro: Instead of teaching through Vedantu, a tutor can run their own online tuition: live batches, recordings, notes and tests on a website with their own domain and their own Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale), where they set the fee and keep the student list. Vedantu calls itself "the top choice for LIVE online classes for K1 to K12". For a teacher, it is a place to apply and teach, not software to buy, so the real comparison is between teaching with Vedantu, running your own tuition, or both.

Teaching with a brand like Vedantu has clear advantages. Students are found for you, timetables and technology are handled, and Vedantu publishes what it says teachers can earn. Running your own tuition gives you your own fee, your own batch size and parents who know your name. You also have to find the students.

We are AllCoaching, and we sell the software for running your own academy, so read this knowing who wrote it. We quote Vedantu only from its own pages, checked on 24 Oct 2026, and we say where teaching with Vedantu is the better choice.
takeaways: Vedantu is a live-class brand, not tuition software: it calls itself "the top choice for LIVE online classes for K1 to K12" and recruits teachers through its become-a-teacher page.
Vedantu publishes earning claims, not a revenue share: its page says "Earning Potential from minimum ₹ 25,000+ per month @ 4h/day upto ₹ 75,000+ per month for full time" (checked 24 Oct 2026).
Vedantu asks for availability: its page lists "Minimum 3 Hours of Daily Availability" between 4 and 10 PM IST.
Your own tuition means your own fee, batch and student list, and finding students yourself. Many tutors do both.
AllCoaching costs ₹6,999 a year + 10% on sales, ₹12,999 + 7.5% or ₹24,999 + 5%, GST extra, after a 7-day free trial with no card needed.
Illustrative: 30 students at ₹800 a month is ₹2.88 lakh a year; on Growth, AllCoaching costs ₹34,599 for that year before GST.
Read any agreement you have signed for exclusivity before you teach your own batches, and ask in writing if it is unclear.

sections.h2: The short answer: three ways to teach online tuition
sections.html:
A tutor looking for a Vedantu alternative has three real options: teach with Vedantu, run your own online tuition, or do both. Teaching with Vedantu suits a tutor who wants students found for them. Your own tuition suits a tutor who already has students, or can find them, and wants to set the fee.

{{fig:verdict|Vedantu alternative for tutors by need: own batches and fees, your own academy on AllCoaching; students assigned and set hours, teach with Vedantu; steady hours and your own batch, do both; a handful of home students, start small|Pick the row that sounds like you.}}

Many CBSE maths and science tutors start with a few home students, add online batches, and then need one place for classes, notes, tests and fees. That is where your own academy helps.

sections.h2: How we compared teaching with Vedantu and running your own tuition
sections.html:
We compared the options on what decides a tuition teacher's month.

  1. Who finds students and talks to parents.
  2. Who sets the fee and the batch size.
  3. Hours: fixed availability or your own timetable.
  4. Income: what is published, and by whom.
  5. Cost and effort to start.
  6. What stays with you: your name, your app, your student list.

For Vedantu we quote only vedantu.com and its become-a-teacher page. Its earning figures are Vedantu's own claims, quoted with the date we read them; we have not verified them.

Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide, and we sell academy software, so we have an interest in the answer. Vedantu's teacher page contains some out-of-date items and earning figures that do not all match each other, so we quote them exactly and attribute them to Vedantu. Every outside figure links to an official page and carries the date we checked it (24 Oct 2026). Terms change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: Why tutors look for a Vedantu alternative
sections.html:
Tutors who look for a Vedantu alternative usually want more control over their own tuition, not a complaint about Vedantu. Here is what a brand offers, and what pulls tutors towards their own practice.

What Vedantu offers a teacher

Vedantu runs live online classes for K-12, CBSE and ICSE students, plus JEE and NEET, and has offline centres.[1] Its become-a-teacher page describes "Earning Potential from minimum ₹ 25,000+ per month @ 4h/day upto ₹ 75,000+ per month for full time", and its FAQ says "On an average, teachers earn more than INR 15000 per month".[2] These are Vedantu's claims, not a published revenue share. For a teacher who wants students supplied and no business to run, that is a real offer.

1. Setting your own hours

Vedantu's page asks for "Minimum 3 Hours of Daily Availability" between 4 and 10 PM IST.[2] That suits many teachers. A school teacher with evening duties, or a tutor with morning home batches, may prefer to set their own timetable.

2. Setting your own fee and batch size

Some tutors want a small class 10 maths batch of 15 at one fee and a board-exam revision batch at another. On your own academy you decide both.

3. Parents who know your name

Tuition grows by word of mouth between parents. When the website and app carry your name, every recommendation brings students to you.

{{q:Isn't joining a brand safer than running my own tuition?|In one way, yes: a brand finds the students, and that is the hardest part. Your own tuition is safer in another way: the students, the fee and the reputation stay with you. Many tutors keep one foot in each until their own batches are full.}}

4. Tuition that has outgrown WhatsApp

A tutor with three batches often runs classes on a video app, notes in Drive, homework on WhatsApp and fees on UPI screenshots. It works until a parent asks for last month's receipt.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after for an online tuition teacher: classes on a video app, fees on UPI screenshots, homework on WhatsApp, notes in Drive, marks in a notebook, compared with one academy login with your own website, app, live classes, checkout and tests|Whatever you decide about Vedantu, your own batches need one home.}}

2. Keep teaching with Vedantu

Good at
Live online classes for K1 to K12, CBSE and ICSE, plus JEE and NEET; it calls itself "the top choice for LIVE online classes for K1 to K12".[1]
Published pay or terms
Vedantu's own earning claims: "₹ 25,000+ per month @ 4h/day upto ₹ 75,000+ per month for full time"; FAQ: "On an average, teachers earn more than INR 15000 per month". Not a published revenue share.[2]

Availability (its page lists a minimum of 3 hours a day between 4 and 10 PM IST), how pay is calculated in your offer, and any exclusivity.

Tutors who want students found for them and are free in the evening slot.

3. Teach for another edtech brand

Good at
Physics Wallah describes itself as an "affordable and comprehensive learning experience" for JEE, NEET and classes 6–12;[3] Unacademy calls itself "India's largest online learning platform".[4]
Published pay or terms
Not published on either website (checked 24 Oct 2026).
Check
Your offer letter and contract, especially exclusivity.
Best for
Teachers who prefer exam batches to school tuition. See our Physics Wallah alternative guide.

4. WhatsApp, a video app and UPI

Good at
Starting today with tools you already have. For a handful of home students, it is enough.
Published price
Free to start; some video apps have paid plans.
Check
No single place for recordings, notes, tests and fee records; it gets harder with every batch.
Best for
Tutors with under ten students who are testing online classes. Read how to become an online tutor in India.

5. A tuition or coaching franchise

Good at
A known brand name and a ready teaching system, for a fee.
Published price
Varies by franchisor and is rarely published.
Check
Upfront fee, any ongoing share, territory rules and what happens if you leave. Our franchise alternative guide covers the questions.
Best for
Tutors who want a borrowed brand and are comfortable sharing income for it.

sections.h2: What your own online tuition costs
sections.html:
Vedantu publishes earning claims, not a fee or revenue share, so there is no like-for-like cost comparison to make. A teaching role and a business are different things. What we can show is what your own tuition costs on AllCoaching at different fee levels.

  • ₹1 lakh of sales a year: ₹16,999 for the year on Starter (plan price + fee on sales, before GST).
  • ₹2.88 lakh of sales a year: ₹34,599 for the year on Growth (plan price + fee on sales, before GST).
  • ₹5 lakh of sales a year: ₹49,999 for the year on Pro (plan price + fee on sales, before GST).

Each figure uses whichever plan costs least at that level: Starter ₹6,999 + 10% below ₹2.4 lakh of fees, Growth ₹12,999 + 7.5% from ₹2.4 to ₹4.8 lakh, Pro ₹24,999 + 5% from ₹4.8 to ₹15 lakh, and Scale ₹99,999 + 0% above ₹15 lakh.

An illustrative example: two batches of 15 class 10 students at ₹800 a month each is 30 × ₹800 × 12 = ₹2.88 lakh of fees a year. On Growth, AllCoaching costs ₹34,599 for that year before GST, and the remaining ₹2,53,401 is yours before your own taxes. The example is illustrative: it assumes every seat is full all year, and you have to find those 30 students yourself.

Hold that against what you could earn teaching the same hours with a brand, and decide what matters more to you: a supplied timetable, or your own practice.

Keep it simple at first. When you reach two or three batches, move them into one academy so recordings, notes and fees sit together. Our guide to the best app for home tutors to manage students and fees compares the options.

Teaching with Vedantu or a similar brand fits, as long as its hours fit your day. Build a small batch of your own on the side if your agreement allows.

Offline tuition centre moving online

Your students and parents already know you. Your own academy lets them attend live, watch recordings and pay online. Read how to move offline coaching online.

faq: What can I use instead of Vedantu to run my own online tuition?

An academy platform you set up yourself. On AllCoaching every plan includes live classes, recordings, notes, tests, UPI and card checkout, a website on your own domain and your own Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale), from ₹6,999 a year plus a 10% fee on sales, GST extra, after a 7-day free trial.
How much does Vedantu pay teachers?

Vedantu does not publish a revenue share. Its become-a-teacher page claims earnings from ₹25,000+ a month at 4 hours a day up to ₹75,000+ a month full time, and its FAQ says teachers earn more than INR 15000 a month on average (checked 24 Oct 2026). These are Vedantu's claims.
What hours does Vedantu ask teachers for?
Vedantu's become-a-teacher page lists a minimum of 3 hours of daily availability between 4 and 10 PM IST (checked 24 Oct 2026).
What is the difference between teaching for a tutoring company and running my own tuition?

A tutoring company finds students, sets the fee and runs the technology, and pays you on its terms. Running your own tuition means you find students and set the fee, and the name, students and income stay with you.

Vedantu's become-a-teacher page describes teaching for earnings and does not mention a franchise. If you are weighing a coaching franchise, compare its upfront fee, any ongoing share and exit terms with running your own tuition.
How do I collect tuition fees online?
Set a fee for each batch and let students or parents pay by UPI or card at checkout on your academy. Payouts reach you automatically through Razorpay, and you keep a record of every payment.
How will parents find my tuition without a big brand?
Mostly through referrals, WhatsApp groups and local search for your subject and class. AllCoaching also lists your courses on its marketplace app, which helps discovery.
Can I teach for Vedantu and run my own tuition?
It depends on your agreement and your hours. Read it for exclusivity and ask Vedantu in writing if it is unclear. This guide is not legal advice.
